text:
ashley_payments: Heads up — HelioTech flagged invoice 992200 (renewal for private deployment) as incorrect. They were supposed to drop from 12 -> 8 nodes mid-month (effective 2026-03-10) but invoice shows full-quarter platform_fee. Also there's a $2,400 "hardware surcharge" line which we don't apply to Private customers. Customer is on payment hold.

kevin_sales: Oof. Did contracting submit the amendment? I thought Priya uploaded it the other day.

priya_contracts: I uploaded amendment 2026-02B on Mar 5 and emailed ops. Effective date in the doc is 2026-03-10. Attached copy to the customer record (amendment_id: 2026-02B). SOW calls for daily proration for capacity changes.

billing-ops: Pulling the invoice. System shows platform_fee $54,000 for 2026-03-01 -> 2026-05-31 (quarterly). Expected platform_fee after proration should be ~$42,800 based on $18k/month at 12 nodes -> $12k/month at 8 nodes with proration. The surcharge line is weird: HWS_SURCHARGE $2,400 sku:hws.surcharge period:2026-03-01 -> 2026-03-31

legal-bot: Quick note: any manual credit must reference amendment 2026-02B and include a simple explanation for audit. No adjustments to past invoices beyond issuing a credit memo.

ashley_payments: Customer sent formal remittance hold note and cc'd their CFO. They want corrected invoice or credit memo by EOD tomorrow.

kevin_sales: Can we fast-track a corrected invoice? If not, issue a credit memo and follow up with regenerated invoice. We lose trust otherwise.

billing-ops: Running amendment-sync status: last run 1769596400, result=success but with warnings: "amendment 2026-02B attached but effective_date not applied to invoice generation due to billing-window boundary bug". Our invoice generator uses effective_date < billing_window_start check; for mid-window changes it should prorate but current code only toggles full-month tiers.

priya_contracts: That's consistent with what I saw in the preview. I set the amendment tag on the account, but the generator didn't calculate partial period.

billing-ops: Short-term options: (A) issue credit memo for overcharge amount ($11,200 estimated) and regenerate next invoice with corrected totals, (B) regenerate and send corrected invoice now (if system can re-run for specific customer), (C) manual journal/adjustment (last resort). Accounting prefers A + regenerated invoice for audit trail.

ashley_payments: Accounting on my side prefers corrected invoice if we can do it today. They want the credit memo only if regen isn't possible. Also ask Sales to send a one-line apology note to the customer.

kevin_sales: I'll draft the note and tag customer success.

billing-ops: I'm going to attempt a targeted re-run: `billing-service --regen-invoice --cust=heliotech --inv=992200`. If it fails within 30 mins we'll create credit memo CM-992200-1.

billing-ops: FYI running quick audit: `select invoice_id, amendment_id from invoices where period_start between '2026-03-01' and '2026-03-31' and amendment_applied=false and customer_segment='private'`. If count>0 we'll open a higher-priority incident.

priya_contracts: Also confirm the HWS_SURCHARGE policy: that surcharge was added for hosted deployments due to new rack contracts. It must not be applied to private on-prem customers. I'll file a policy exception ticket for ops to remove the surcharge retroactively if appended in error.

legal-bot: Reminder: include amendment id and ticket refs in any credit memo. We also need the support ticket number if they reported an outage tied to capacity change.

billing-ops: Re-run succeeded: regenerated invoice 992200-v2 created at 1769602400. New line items:
```
PLATFORM_FEE    $42,800    sku:platform_fee.private    period:2026-03-01 -> 2026-05-31    notes: proration applied for 2026-03-10 effective
HWS_SURCHARGE   $0         sku:hws.surcharge        period:2026-03-01 -> 2026-03-31    notes: not applicable to private deployments
```

ashley_payments: Great. Please post the corrected PDF and the credit memo doc for the $11,200 overcharge so I can send to customer.

billing-ops: Credit memo CM-992200-1 drafted at 1769602500: "Credit for platform fee proration per amendment 2026-02B and removal of inapplicable hardware surcharge." Attaching GL reversal codes.

kevin_sales: Sending apology note + corrected invoice to HelioTech now. CC'ing acctmgr@redwood and procurement@heliotech.

ashley_payments: Customer replied: "Thanks — please confirm credit memo on our AR and we'll release PO. Appreciate the quick turnaround."

billing-ops: Audit query returned 2 additional private customers with amendments in March not applied. Opening #finance-alerts incident and scheduling a batch job to re-run regen for those accounts overnight.

priya_contracts: Thx everyone. I'll update the amendment records and follow up with a short post-mortem on the ingestion bug so we can fix generator logic
